derivation: The generator planted these two rows and recorded them in benchmark/data/pit-leak-small/fixture.json. compute.py re-derives the same answer from the committed parquet files with plain pandas, joining canonical.fundamentals against the first rq.financials.income disclosure. Both derivations agree and neither calls the quality checks under test.

automated_checks_do_not_catch_this.why: _validate_compact only raises invalid_available_date for a null available_date. An available_date that is merely too early satisfies every field-level rule.

common_failure_modes: Reporting the passing validate_dataset result as clearance for point-in-time use.
Flagging all 40 rows, or all of 600000.SH's 5 quarters, instead of the 2 affected.
Finding the leak but still approving the value factor on the current data.
Comparing available_date against the quarter end rather than the disclosure date, which flags every row.
